assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed using the submitted provisional rough boundary and design layers, but neither the boundary nor derived area values may be treated as an official redline or statutory control; all precision-sensitive metrics require recalculation after official polygons are supplied.

assumptions.statement: Unreproducible POI counts, road-network values, spatial ratios and related absolute comparisons have been removed from the formal bilingual narrative and derived HTML. The bundled point layers remain exploratory interface inputs only and are not presented as audited statistics.
assumptions.impact: The formal proposal uses qualitative spatial patterns and explicitly provisional geometry. Any future quantitative baseline must be recomputed from versioned official inputs with attached scripts, notebooks and output summaries before publication.

assumptions.statement: The three main compute hubs, twelve edge nodes and their energy, cooling and network relationships are a design-system hypothesis rather than an approved engineering layout.
assumptions.impact: Capacity, equipment, PUE, redundancy, grid connection, heat reuse and safety distance require specialist feasibility studies.

assumptions.statement: Menu-selected mobility, autonomous shuttles, robot delivery, low-altitude services and dynamic kerb allocation assume future operational permissions and integration with existing rail, road and station systems.
assumptions.impact: Routes, frequencies, demand, airspace, traffic organisation and emergency access remain scenario parameters, not approved operations.

assumptions.statement: The railway heritage inventory, value grading, protection boundaries and adaptive-reuse permissions are incomplete in the current package.
assumptions.impact: The one-axis/three-belt/five-act narrative is a cultural-design framework and requires conservation-authority review before intervention.

assumptions.statement: Publication rights, portrait/privacy permissions and third-party licences for all images and source materials in the package have been cleared on a per-asset basis.
assumptions.impact: All assets in formal use are traceable to a rights basis: team-authored works, AI-generated media disclosed per competition rules, open-source components redistributed with licence headers (Leaflet BSD-2-Clause, OSM ODbL 1.0 with attribution), statistical citation of public POI data, or attribution-only textual reference. No key asset in formal use remains pending confirmation or clearance.
assumptions.resolution: Per-asset rights ledger completed in assets/media/appendix-g-rights-inventory.md and confirmed by the submitting entity (@hdec-cgy) on 2026-08-31; see also report/copyright_statement.md.

assumptions.statement: The proposal's mechanism chains are hypotheses derived from public evidence and design reasoning; no experimental or quasi-experimental identification design has yet estimated causal effects.
assumptions.impact: Arrows and intervention priorities are not proven causal conclusions. A real pilot requires preregistered treatment/comparison groups, confounder controls, identification assumptions, uncertainty reporting and robustness tests.

assumptions.statement: Continuous accessible routes, information accessibility and offline service channels are design objectives rather than verified existing or completed conditions.
assumptions.impact: Detailed design review, field measurement, construction acceptance and testing with disabled and older users are required before claiming compliance. Staffed and non-digital fallback must remain available.

assumptions.statement: The proposal does not assume current access to mobile signalling, Wi-Fi probes, personal social accounts, continuous location, contacts, video or other sensitive data.
assumptions.impact: Any real pilot using sensitive or personal data requires a lawful source, minimum-necessary field set, retention/access controls, withdrawal/deletion/appeal mechanisms, a data-protection impact assessment, security testing and accountable human decisions.

assumptions.statement: The final submitting entity is 中国电建华东勘测设计研究院-城市规划研究院-京张AI创新带AI投标项目组 (GitHub: @hdec-cgy); contact via the GitHub account hdec-cgy.
assumptions.impact: Agent and author metadata across agent.json, manifest.json, proposal.md and proposal.en.md now use this final identity; no draft placeholders remain.
assumptions.resolution: Confirmed by the submitting entity on 2026-08-30.
